items.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Replace passenger airbag inflator or module
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under recall 16V-384, 19V-001. Check your VIN first.

items.t: ABS valves stick, brake pedal travels farther

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under recall 19V-904. Check your VIN first.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under recall 16V-875, 19V-590. Check your VIN first.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under recall 23V-162. Check your VIN first.

items.note: Head gasket repairs rarely last on this engine. Ask a dealer about any goodwill help.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under recall 25V-685. Check your VIN first.

items.job: Replace battery energy control module and update
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under recall 23V-440. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera blank or distorted
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under recall 25V-695, 25V-442. Check your VIN first.

items.t: AWD power transfer unit leak or burnt fluid
items.job: Replace leaking PTU intermediate shaft seal and refill gear oil
items.note: Labor from Ford TSB 18-2255/19-2017 (2013-2018 AWD; PTU stays in the car); gear oil extra. If the PTU itself is worn, a used or rebuilt unit is about $1,300 and owners report $2,000-$2,800 total (TrueDelta).

items.t: Throttle body fault causes limp mode
items.note: Parts: OEM throttle body $252 sale / $435 list (1A Auto). No source states a labor time, so hours are worked back from estimator totals: YourMechanic 2011 3.0L $390 (shops $453-$637); RepairPal 2009 $676-$953. Ask Ford about extended coverage under program 13N03 first.

items.t: Rattle from cracked flexplate
items.job: Replace flexplate and torque converter (transmission removed)
items.note: Labor from Ford program 22N12 (2019-2020 Fusion 2.0L: 9.9 hrs FWD, 11.7 hrs AWD; 1.9 hrs if the borescope check passes). Parts: flexplate $71-$110 plus torque converter $326-$480 (Ford); Ford also replaces the transmission pump. Program 22N12 covered eligible cars free up to 10 years/100,000 miles.

items.t: Oil pan seal leak
items.job: Replace oil pan (new press-in-place gasket) and oil pump seal
items.note: Labor from Ford TSB 19-2387, which replaced TSB 19-2249 (2018-2019 Fusion 2.7L: 3.4 hrs, plus 0.6 hrs for a toe check). Oil pan KT4Z-6675-D is $127 sale / $198 list; oil and filter extra.
